claims.neutralSummary: Audi A5 Avant için DRIVING_ENGAGEMENT karakteri iki bağımsız güncel editoryal incelemede ortak sinyal veriyor.
locators: Performance & driving experience The A5 feels solid and secure rather than fun to drive.

Performance and drive comfort The diesel engine is a lovely thing for motorway driving, but can be a bit unrefined at lower speeds In town The Audi A5 uses advanced mild-hybrid technology, which means you don’t quite get the all-electric driving capabilities of a proper hybrid , but you can pootle around at lower speeds without engaging the combustion engine.

claims.neutralSummary: Audi A5 Avant için COMFORT karakteri iki bağımsız güncel editoryal incelemede ortak sinyal veriyor.
locators: As you'll discover on the Driving tab, the A5's dynamics simply aren't as sorted as a 3 Series or Giulia's, and although it's certainly more spirited than a C-Class, the Merc at least has the excuse of going all-in for comfort.
The BMW 3 Series offers a more responsive and dynamic feel, while the Mercedes C-Class has a slight edge in terms of comfort.

claims.neutralSummary: Audi A5 Avant için PRACTICALITY karakteri iki bağımsız güncel editoryal incelemede ortak sinyal veriyor.
locators: If you prioritise the drive over practicality then the A5 is leaps ahead of any of the SUVs in the Audi camp, but it doesn’t have the same cabin and luggage space of a taller 4x4.
It’s also more practical than the old A4, thanks to having a hatchback tailgate rather than the restrictive letterbox-style opening of a traditional saloon car.

claims.neutralSummary: Audi A5 Avant için TECHNOLOGY karakteri iki bağımsız güncel editoryal incelemede ortak sinyal veriyor.
locators: Performance and drive comfort Space and practicality Interior style, infotainment and accessories MPG, emissions and tax Safety and security Reliability and problems Audi A5 Saloon FAQs Is the Audi A5 a good car?
